name: pendulum-wave
title: Pendulum Wave
description: A row of pendulums drifts out of phase into waves, then snaps back into a straight line.
useWhen: A scene needs a calm, hypnotic background loop that is clearly rule-based, with order dissolving into waves and snapping back into a line.
A section about timing, rhythm, sync or periodic systems needs a visual that shows phases drifting apart and realigning.
avoidWhen: The loop should be a dense, organic texture rather than a row of distinct objects.
The scene needs a one-shot accent that fires and clears rather than a running loop: use trim-burst.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Pendulums
variables.description: Number of pendulums in the row.

variables.label: Cycles
variables.description: Swings the slowest pendulum makes per loop; pendulum i makes cycles + i.

variables.label: Loop length
variables.description: Frames (at 30 fps) until every pendulum realigns.

variables.label: Bobs
variables.description: Color of the bobs and guides.

variables.label: Wave line
variables.description: Color of the line threaded through the bobs.

variables.label: Guides
variables.description: Draw the faint per-pendulum tracks and centre line.
